tagline: A Private Resort Homestay in Varkala, Kerala
address: North Cliff Road, Kurakkanni, Varkala, Kerala 695141, India
defaultSeoTitle: Royal Palace | Luxury Resort Homestay in Varkala, Kerala
defaultSeoDescription: A private boutique resort homestay overlooking the cliff & coast of Varkala, Kerala. Quiet luxury, tropical elegance, cinematic slow living.

name: Royal Cliff Suite
shortDescription: Panoramic Arabian ocean views, private teak balcony, plunge pool, and bespoke luxury interiors.
description: Perched high on the cliffside, the Royal Cliff Suite is our flagship private sanctuary. Featuring hand-carved Malabar teak woodwork, high timber ceilings, an expansive oceanfront private balcony, and an intimate plunge pool overlooking the Arabian Sea.

name: Heritage Teak Villa
shortDescription: A two-bedroom traditional Kerala wooden villa surrounded by lush coconut groves and secret courtyards.
description: Inspired by traditional Kerala Tharavadu architecture, this standalone villa combines hundred-year-old carved teak elements with contemporary high-end luxury. Perfect for families or small groups seeking absolute privacy.

name: Palace Garden Sanctuary
shortDescription: Serene garden-level room immersed in tropical greenery with private sun-dappled veranda.
description: Tucked within our private botanical gardens, the Palace Garden Sanctuary offers a quiet retreat sheltered by coconut palms and frangipani blossoms. Wake up to soft birdsong and cool ocean breezes.

title: Varkala Cliff Sunset & Mineral Springs
shortDescription: Guided golden hour walk along the dramatic red cliffs of Varkala down to the natural freshwater spring.
description: Experience the legendary golden hour of Varkala. Walk along the edge of towering red clay cliffs carved by the Arabian Sea, down to the sacred Papanasam mineral springs where natural freshwater trickles straight from the rock into the ocean waves.

title: Edava Paravur Kayaking & Backwater Trail
shortDescription: Glide silently through tranquil backwaters, mangrove tunnels, and quiet coconut palm canals.
description: Paddle through the serene backwater lakes of Edava and Kappil where fresh water meets the sea. Witness traditional canoe fishermen, blue kingfishers, and peaceful water lilies in absolute morning calm.

title: Authentic Malabar Culinary Tasting
shortDescription: Private chef dining featuring fresh ocean catch, banana leaf meals, and Kerala coconut curries.
description: A curated epicurean journey through Kerala's famous spice coast. Prepared daily using fresh fish bought directly from local fishermen at dawn and organic spices grown in nearby hill estates.

quote: Royal Palace is unlike any hotel in Kerala. It feels like staying in a friend's architectural luxury villa. The ocean views from the cliff suite sunset were breathtaking.
The quietness, the smell of teak wood, the private backwater kayaking in the morning... Royal Palace delivered the calmest 4 days of our lives.

title: Monsoon & Winter Coastal Escape
description: Book 3 nights or more at Royal Palace and receive complimentary sunrise kayaking and private coastal seafood dinner.

sections.title: MORE THAN A STAY. A SLOWER WAY TO EXPERIENCE VARKALA.
bodyParagraphs: Set atop the iconic cliffs of Varkala where ancient red earth meets the deep blue Arabian ocean, Royal Palace is a private boutique sanctuary crafted for thoughtful travelers.
Here, days unfold with intention: soft sea air blowing through teak shutters, fresh coconut water served on sunlit verandas, and quiet evenings watching the sun dip into the horizon.
sections.quote: Quiet luxury born from Kerala wood, sea salt, and unhurried time.
